cross_references.relationship: PARENT_STATUTE — §1028A is a sentencing enhancement; §1028 is the substantive identity theft crime. Flores-Figueroa knowledge requirement cross-applies.
ENUMERATED_PREDICATE — §1343 is listed in §1028A(c)(4). Wire fraud conviction + §1028A use of real identity = mandatory consecutive 2 years.
RICO_COMPOUND — §1028A predicates can be RICO predicates under §1961(1)(B) (listed offenses). Pattern of §1028A acts + §1343 acts = civil RICO treble damages.
CIVIL_PARALLEL — §1681c-2 identity theft block is the civil remedy for the same conduct §1028A punishes criminally. Both should be referenced in the same victim-compensation strategy.
